description: Flat metadata schema for metagenome-assembled genomes from marine microbial communities, covering sampling context, environmental conditions, cell disruption, sequencing, assembly, and quality assessment.

record_id.descr: Unique identifier for the metadata record or MAG (e.g., sample-specific genome ID).

sample_id.descr: Identifier linking the MAG to the original marine sample.

collection_site_name.descr: Name of the oceanic collection site or station.

collection_site_id.descr: Standardized site or station code, if available.

water_depth_m.descr: Depth of seawater collection in meters below sea surface.

collection_date.descr: Date when the marine sample was collected.

collection_time.descr: Local or UTC time of sample collection, if available.

collection_method.descr: Method used to obtain the marine sample (e.g., Niskin bottle, pump filtration, rosette).

sample_matrix.descr: Sample material type, expected values such as seawater, sediment, or mixed marine particulate fraction.

temperature_c.descr: In situ or measured temperature at sampling depth in degrees Celsius.

salinity_psu.descr: Salinity at collection site in practical salinity units (PSU).

ph.descr: pH of the sampled water or environment.

dissolved_oxygen_mg_l.descr: Dissolved oxygen concentration in mg/L, if measured.

nutrient_description.descr: Free-text or standardized description of nutrient conditions measured at the site (e.g., nitrate, phosphate, silicate).

chlorophyll_a_ug_l.descr: Chlorophyll a concentration in micrograms per liter, if available.

pressure_dbar.descr: Hydrostatic pressure at sampling depth in decibars, if available.

cell_disruption_method_chemical.descr: Chemical cell disruption reagent or protocol used for lysis (e.g., SDS, lysozyme, CTAB).

cell_disruption_method_mechanical.descr: Mechanical disruption method used for lysis (e.g., bead beating, homogenization, sonication).

cell_disruption_protocol.descr: Combined cell disruption workflow description or protocol name.

dna_extraction_method.descr: DNA extraction kit, reagent set, or protocol used prior to sequencing.

library_preparation_method.descr: Library preparation protocol or kit used for sequencing library construction.

sequencing_platform.descr: Sequencing platform used (e.g., Illumina NovaSeq, PacBio HiFi, Oxford Nanopore).

sequencing_instrument_model.descr: Specific instrument model used for sequencing, if available.

sequencing_read_type.descr: Read configuration such as single-end, paired-end, long-read, or hybrid.

read_length_bp.descr: Read length in base pairs for short-read sequencing, if applicable.

sequencing_coverage_x.descr: Estimated sequencing depth/coverage for the genome, if available.

sequencing_run_id.descr: Identifier for the sequencing run or flow cell.

assembler_software.descr: Software used for genome assembly (e.g., MEGAHIT, metaSPAdes, Flye).

assembly_parameters.descr: Key non-default assembly parameters or command-line settings used.

binning_software.descr: Software used to bin contigs into MAGs, if applicable.

quality_assessment_software.descr: Software used to assess MAG quality (e.g., CheckM, BUSCO, GUNC).

quality_assessment_version.descr: Version of the quality assessment software.

strain_heterogeneity_pct.descr: Estimated strain heterogeneity in percent, if assessed.

contig_count.descr: Number of contigs in the assembled genome bin.

genome_size_bp.descr: Estimated assembled genome size in base pairs.

taxonomy_domain.descr: Assigned taxonomic domain, typically Bacteria or Archaea.

taxonomy_species.descr: Assigned taxonomic species or species-level cluster, if available.

functional_annotation_software.descr: Software used for gene prediction or functional annotation, if performed.

functional_annotation_version.descr: Version of the functional annotation software.

genome_accession.descr: Public database accession for the MAG or assembled genome, if deposited.

raw_reads_accession.descr: Accession for raw sequencing reads, if deposited in a public archive.

assembly_accession.descr: Accession for the genome assembly, if deposited in a public archive.

license.descr: Reuse license or data use terms, if applicable.
